curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42032-1-2.pdf (the tracked loader, numbered 1 on its cover); omr/instructions/42032-1-1.pdf builds the B model

functions.does: The gear-wheel knob at the back turns a worm, which turns a 24-tooth gear behind the cab; cranks on the gear's axle push links that raise and lower the two loader arms, carrying the bucket and the fork with them. The worm holds the arms wherever they're left.
functions.source: book: steps 4-10 (pages 7-9), arms step 21 (pages 24-28), page 52 (the function pictures)

functions.does: The upright lever on the left loader arm tilts the bucket: rocking it pushes a long white link along the arm to the bucket's back.
functions.source: book: page 52 (left picture, the arrow on the lever; the right picture shows the bucket tipped), arms step 21 (pages 26-27), bucket step 23 (page 30); inferred: which lever works the bucket and which the fork, from the links' sides

functions.does: The upright lever on the right loader arm tilts the fork above the bucket up and down, through a long white link along the arm.
functions.source: book: page 52 (left picture, the arrow on the lever), arms step 21 (pages 26-27), fork steps 26-27 (pages 37-41); inferred: which lever works the fork, from the link's side

functions.does: The two tracks run round their wheels, so the loader rolls along.

questions.question: Which knob does which, where the book doesn't label them?
